forcedChoices.reason: Matches the glossary short form 'orden secundaria de criaturas intermedias'; used the same in 121:8.12.

forcedChoices.choice: año 39 d. C. (era abbreviation after the number)
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish puts a. C. / d. C. after the year; the scaps span is kept. Same in all of 121:8.
The text addresses the reader; the Spanish rules ask for plural ustedes.

forcedChoices.choice: vuelco del sentimiento for 'reversion of feeling'
forcedChoices.reason: The glossary term 'reversión' carries the coined sense of recall of past memories; here the English means a plain reversal.

forcedChoices.choice: concepto humano efectivo for 'actual human concept'
forcedChoices.reason: Plain sense 'real', not the philosophical 'en acto'; 'efectivo' avoids the false friend and the coined term.

forcedChoices.choice: generaciones transcurridas desde entonces for 'intervening generations'
forcedChoices.reason: 'intermedias' would read as the midwayer term (seres intermedios) in the same sentence.

forcedChoices.choice: Evangelio de Marcos / de Lucas for 'Gospel by'
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish has no natural form that separates 'by' from 'of' in a title; 'según' is kept for 'according to'.
